name: Alberta Innovates
eligibilitySummary: Alberta's provincial innovation agency providing R&D funding and support for technology-driven companies. Covers applied research, prototype development, and technology validation projects across multiple sectors.

funding.description: R&D grants ranging from $50,000 to $500,000. Funding covers up to 50% of eligible project costs including salaries, materials, and subcontractor fees for applied research and development.

application.applicationRequirements: Must be an Alberta-based company or have significant Alberta operations. Project must demonstrate technological innovation with clear commercialization path. Requires matching funds from other sources.
